description: Source code implementing IPv6 Control Protocol (IPv6CP) for PPP in Zephyr OS, including functions for handling, configuration, address management, and state transitions.

methods.name: ipv6cp_handle
methods.description: Handles incoming IPv6CP packets, passing them to the FSM input handler.

methods.name: ipv6cp_add_iid
methods.description: Adds interface identifier (IID) to the packet based on link address.

methods.name: ipv6cp_ack_iid
methods.description: Acknowledges received IID, verifying it matches the requested IID.

methods.name: ipv6cp_interface_identifier_parse
methods.description: Parses the interface identifier option from incoming packets.

methods.name: ipv6cp_config_info_req
methods.description: Handles configuration request, extracting peer IID.

methods.name: ipv6cp_config_info_ack
methods.description: Processes acknowledgment of configuration info, verifying IID acknowledgment.

methods.name: ipv6cp_lower_down
methods.description: Handles lower layer down event for IPv6CP.

methods.name: ipv6cp_lower_up
methods.description: Handles lower layer up event for IPv6CP.

methods.name: ipv6cp_close
methods.description: Closes the IPv6CP FSM with a reason.

methods.name: setup_iid_address
methods.description: Sets up IPv6 address with IID.

methods.name: add_iid_address
methods.description: Adds IPv6 address with IID to interface.

methods.name: ipv6cp_up
methods.description: Handles IPv6CP protocol up event, configuring addresses and neighbor cache.

methods.name: ipv6cp_down
methods.description: Handles IPv6CP protocol down event, removing addresses and neighbor cache entries.

methods.name: ipv6cp_proto_reject
methods.description: Handles protocol rejection by shutting down FSM.

methods.name: ipv6cp_init
methods.description: Initializes IPv6CP FSM and registers protocol.
